Remaining unmatched PDF lines are HTML-table bodies (Tables 1-8 compared structurally), figure-internal diagram labels (pp.4-5), benchmark comparison sub-rows present inside the tables (pp.7-9), Box B.1/B.2 data-format examples on p.19 (typeset vector text inside the recorded box images, already embedded as images per the package), reference wrap continuations (pp.11-14), and the print's own misspelling "stuning" on p.3, present in the PDF text layer and preserved. Bulleted lists on pp.3 and 10 were confirmed present in the OCR.
